+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Group inference for NARPS Hypothesis 1, AO86 equal-indifference gain cope maps.
+
+Primary: one-sample random-effects t test with one-sided whole-brain max-T
+sign-flip permutation FWE correction. No first-level variance maps are supplied,
+so participants receive equal weight. All randomization and masks are deterministic.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import hashlib
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+import nibabel as nib
+from scipy import stats
+from nilearn import datasets, image, plotting
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUT = ROOT / "results"
+FIG = ROOT / "figures"
+DATA = ROOT / "input" / "data"
+N_PERM = 9999
+SEED = 8601
+ALPHA = .05
+
+meta = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "input" / "participants.tsv", sep="\t")
+files = sorted(DATA.glob("sub-*_hypo1_cope.nii.gz"))
+file_ids = [p.name.split("_")[0] for p in files]
+assert len(files) == 54 and set(file_ids) == set(meta.participant_id)
+meta = meta.set_index("participant_id").loc[file_ids].reset_index()
+imgs = [nib.load(str(p)) for p in files]
+ref = imgs[0]
+for p, im in zip(files, imgs):
+    assert im.shape == ref.shape, f"shape mismatch: {p.name}"
+    assert np.allclose(im.affine, ref.affine, atol=1e-5), f"affine mismatch: {p.name}"
+
+# An independent standard MNI brain mask, nearest-neighbor resampled to the
+# supplied MNI152NLin2009cAsym grid. Positive-coverage voxels inside brain only.
+std_mask = datasets.load_mni152_brain_mask(resolution=2)
+mask_img = image.resample_to_img(std_mask, ref, interpolation="nearest", force_resample=True)
+brain = np.asarray(mask_img.dataobj) > 0
+Yvol = np.stack([np.asarray(im.dataobj, dtype=np.float32) for im in imgs], axis=0)
+finite = np.isfinite(Yvol).all(axis=0)
+# NIfTI zeros mark locations outside each participant's estimation mask in this
+# collection. Use their intersection so no fabricated zero observations enter
+# the group test; an exactly zero floating-point contrast throughout all maps
+# is vanishingly unlikely.
+coverage = np.all(Yvol != 0, axis=0)
+mask = brain & finite & coverage
+assert mask.sum() > 50000
+Y = Yvol[:, mask].astype(np.float64, copy=False)
+n, v = Y.shape
+
+# One-sample t and one-sided parametric p maps for descriptive comparison.
+mean = Y.mean(axis=0)
+sd = Y.std(axis=0, ddof=1)
+tobs = mean / (sd / np.sqrt(n))
+p_unc = stats.t.sf(tobs, df=n-1)
+
+# Sign-flip randomization under the null of symmetric participant effects.
+# For each sign vector, calculate all voxel statistics and retain its maximum.
+rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
+max_t = np.empty(N_PERM, dtype=np.float64)
+sumsq = np.einsum("ij,ij->j", Y, Y)
+batch = 64
+for start in range(0, N_PERM, batch):
+    b = min(batch, N_PERM-start)
+    signs = rng.choice(np.array([-1., 1.]), size=(b, n))
+    sums = signs @ Y
+    denom2 = (sumsq[None, :] - sums*sums/n) / (n-1)
+    ts = (sums / n) / np.sqrt(np.maximum(denom2, 1e-30) / n)
+    max_t[start:start+b] = np.max(ts, axis=1)
+p_fwe = (1 + (max_t[:, None] >= tobs[None, :]).sum(axis=0)) / (N_PERM + 1)
+
+# Convert maps back to reference image space.
+def out_img(vals):
+    arr = np.zeros(ref.shape, dtype=np.float32)
+    arr[mask] = np.asarray(vals, dtype=np.float32)
+    return nib.Nifti1Image(arr, ref.affine, ref.header)
+t_img = out_img(tobs)
+p_img = out_img(p_fwe)
+mean_img = out_img(mean)
+for name, im in [("mean_gain_effect.nii.gz", mean_img), ("t_statistic.nii.gz", t_img), ("p_fwe_maxT.nii.gz", p_img)]:
+    nib.save(im, OUT / name)
+
+# A fixed, broad anatomical vmPFC core envelope in MNI coordinates, used only
+# for an interpretable descriptive summary. Inference remains whole-brain.
+ijk = np.indices(ref.shape).reshape(3, -1).T
+xyz = nib.affines.apply_affine(ref.affine, ijk)
+roi_flat = ((np.abs(xyz[:,0]) <= 15) & (xyz[:,1] >= 20) & (xyz[:,1] <= 55) &
+            (xyz[:,2] >= -20) & (xyz[:,2] <= 5))
+roi = roi_flat.reshape(ref.shape) & mask
+assert roi.sum() > 20
+roi_vals = Yvol[:, roi]
+subj_roi = roi_vals.mean(axis=1)
+roi_mean = subj_roi.mean()
+roi_sd = subj_roi.std(ddof=1)
+roi_se = roi_sd / np.sqrt(n)
+roi_ci = stats.t.interval(.95, n-1, loc=roi_mean, scale=roi_se)
+roi_t = roi_mean / roi_se
+roi_p = stats.t.sf(roi_t, n-1)
+
+# Peak and cluster-like extent in max-T FWE-significant voxels (voxelwise FWE).
+sig = p_fwe <= ALPHA
+sig_count = int(sig.sum())
+sig_t_img = out_img(np.where(sig, tobs, 0.0))
+nib.save(sig_t_img, OUT / "t_fwe_significant.nii.gz")
+peak_idx = None
+if sig_count:
+    peak_local = np.argmax(np.where(sig, tobs, -np.inf))
+    peak_idx = np.argwhere(mask)[peak_local]
+    peak_xyz = nib.affines.apply_affine(ref.affine, peak_idx)
+    peak_t = float(tobs[peak_local]); peak_pfwe = float(p_fwe[peak_local])
+else:
+    peak_xyz = None; peak_t = None; peak_pfwe = None
+
+# QC metrics and checks.
+nonzero_frac = np.mean(Yvol != 0, axis=(1,2,3))
+subj_whole_mean = Y.mean(axis=1)
+qc = {
+  "n_maps": len(files), "n_metadata": len(meta), "all_metadata_ids_matched": True,
+  "excluded_participants": [], "common_grid_shape": list(ref.shape),
+  "voxel_sizes_mm": [float(x) for x in ref.header.get_zooms()[:3]],
+  "reference_affine": ref.affine.tolist(), "whole_brain_mask_voxels": int(mask.sum()),
+  "vmPFC_core_mask_voxels": int(roi.sum()), "map_nonzero_fraction_range": [float(nonzero_frac.min()), float(nonzero_frac.max())],
+  "participant_whole_brain_mean_range": [float(subj_whole_mean.min()), float(subj_whole_mean.max())],
+  "participant_vmPFC_mean_range": [float(subj_roi.min()), float(subj_roi.max())]
+}
+summary = {
+  "analysis": "one-sample equal-weight random-effects t test; positive gain effect",
+  "n": n, "df": n-1, "mask_voxels": v, "permutations": N_PERM,
+  "permutation_seed": SEED, "test": "one-sided sign-flip max-T voxelwise family-wise error control",
+  "alpha": ALPHA, "vmPFC_roi_definition_mni_mm": {"x": [-15,15], "y": [20,55], "z": [-20,5]},
+  "vmPFC_roi_role": "descriptive summary only; confirmatory inference uses full brain mask",
+  "vmPFC_roi_mean_effect": float(roi_mean), "vmPFC_roi_sd_between_participants": float(roi_sd),
+  "vmPFC_roi_se": float(roi_se), "vmPFC_roi_95ci": [float(roi_ci[0]), float(roi_ci[1])],
+  "vmPFC_roi_t": float(roi_t), "vmPFC_roi_uncorrected_one_sided_p": float(roi_p),
+  "whole_brain_maxT_fwe_significant_voxels": sig_count,
+  "peak_if_significant_mni_mm": None if peak_xyz is None else [float(q) for q in peak_xyz],
+  "peak_t": peak_t, "peak_p_fwe": peak_pfwe,
+  "most_extreme_wholebrain_t": float(tobs.max()), "most_extreme_wholebrain_mni_mm": [float(q) for q in nib.affines.apply_affine(ref.affine, np.argwhere(mask)[np.argmax(tobs)])],
+  "maxT_95pct_critical_t": float(np.quantile(max_t, .95)),
+  "n_voxels_uncorrected_p_lt_0_001": int((p_unc < .001).sum()),
+  "qc": qc
+}
+(OUT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+# Figure 1: group t statistic on sagittal and coronal slices, with vmPFC envelope outline.
+fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))
+plotting.plot_stat_map(t_img, bg_img=datasets.load_mni152_template(resolution=2),
+    display_mode="x", cut_coords=[0], threshold=stats.t.ppf(.999, n-1),
+    cmap="cold_hot", colorbar=True, vmax=max(4, float(np.nanpercentile(tobs,99.9))),
+    axes=axes[0], title="Group t map (display threshold p < .001 uncorrected)")
+plotting.plot_stat_map(t_img, bg_img=datasets.load_mni152_template(resolution=2),
+    display_mode="y", cut_coords=[35], threshold=stats.t.ppf(.999, n-1),
+    cmap="cold_hot", colorbar=True, vmax=max(4, float(np.nanpercentile(tobs,99.9))),
+    axes=axes[1], title="Coronal view through vmPFC")
+fig.suptitle("NARPS equal-indifference gain effect (n=54)", fontsize=13)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(FIG / "group_t_map.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Corrected whole-brain findings, plotted at the peak and vmPFC midsagittal plane.
+fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 4.2))
+for ax, mode, coord, title in [
+    (axes[0], "x", -26, "Sagittal: peak x = -26"),
+    (axes[1], "y", -102, "Coronal: peak y = -102"),
+    (axes[2], "z", -4, "Axial: peak z = -4"),
+]:
+    plotting.plot_stat_map(sig_t_img, bg_img=datasets.load_mni152_template(resolution=2),
+        display_mode=mode, cut_coords=[coord], threshold=0, cmap="cold_hot",
+        colorbar=True, axes=ax, title=title)
+fig.suptitle("Positive voxels surviving one-sided whole-brain max-T FWE (p ≤ .05)", fontsize=12)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(FIG / "whole_brain_fwe_findings.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Figure 2: participant vmPFC ROI effect distribution and group estimate.
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))
+ax.scatter(np.arange(1,n+1), subj_roi, s=24, color="#345995", alpha=.8)
+ax.axhline(roi_mean, color="#c44536", lw=2, label=f"Mean = {roi_mean:.3f}")
+ax.axhspan(roi_ci[0], roi_ci[1], color="#c44536", alpha=.15, label="95% t interval")
+ax.axhline(0, color="black", lw=.8)
+ax.set(xlabel="Participant (ordered by ID)", ylabel="Mean gain contrast estimate in vmPFC core", title="Participant-level vmPFC gain effect")
+ax.legend(frameon=False); fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(FIG / "vmPFC_participant_effects.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))

+"""Add clearly attributed navigation only when no original root README exists."""
+from pathlib import Path

+import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess,sys,traceback
+root=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();repo=root/'publisher';prepared=json.loads((root/'prepared.json').read_text())
+pixi=['pixi','run','--manifest-path','/Users/johnlee/code/CON/stamped-in-practice/pixi.toml','--locked'];commands=[]
+def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+def save(p,v):p.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
+def run(argv,allow=False):
+    p=subprocess.run(list(map(str,argv)),cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True)
+    commands.append({'argv':list(map(str,argv)),'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})
+    save(root/'commands-navigation.json',commands)
+    if not allow:p.check_returncode()
+    return p
+try:
+    assert not (root/'navigation.json').exists()
+    assert run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).stdout.strip()==prepared['parent_commit']
+    original_readme=any(e['published_path']=='README.md' for e in prepared['copied_files'])
+    original_readme=original_readme or bool(run(['git','ls-tree','HEAD','README.md']).stdout.strip())
+    evidence=repo/'coordinator/browsable-copy-01';paths=[]
+    if not original_readme:
+        assert not (repo/'README.md').exists() and not (repo/'README.md').is_symlink()
+        files=[e['published_path'] for e in prepared['copied_files'] if e['kind']=='file' and not e['published_path'].startswith('.')]
+        links=[p for p in files if Path(p).name.lower().startswith(('report','protocol')) or Path(p).suffix.lower() in {'.py','.r','.m','.sh','.ipynb','.png','.svg','.jpg','.jpeg','.webp'}]
+        text='# '+prepared['run_id']+'\n\nCoordinator navigation for this stopped experiment. Original scientific files are copied unchanged from its captured delivery.\n\n'
+        text+='\n'.join('- ['+p+']('+quote(p,safe='/')+')' for p in links)
+        text+='\n\nThe [complete original archive](coordinator/delivery-01/delivery.tar.gz) remains authoritative. See the [copy manifest](coordinator/browsable-copy-01/manifest.json) for source hashes and storage, and [coordinator records](coordinator/README.md) for preservation provenance. This navigation adds no scientific execution or worker credit.\n'
+        (repo/'README.md').write_text(text)
+        cmd=pixi+['pre-commit','run','--config','/Users/johnlee/code/CON/stamped-in-practice/.pre-commit-config.yaml','snapper','--files','README.md']
+        if run(cmd,allow=True).returncode:run(cmd)
+        paths.append('README.md')
+    if (root/'root-review-01.json').exists():
+        dest=evidence/'review/root-review-01.json';dest.parent.mkdir();shutil.copy2(root/'root-review-01.json',dest)
+        paths.append(str(dest.relative_to(repo)))
+    shutil.copy2(Path(__file__),evidence/'add-navigation.py');paths.append('coordinator/browsable-copy-01/add-navigation.py')
+    result={'coordinator_root_readme_added':not original_readme,'original_root_readme_preserved':bool(original_readme),
+      'prepared_sha256':sha(root/'prepared.json'),'files':[{'path':p,'sha256':sha(repo/p)} for p in paths]}
+    save(evidence/'navigation.json',result);paths.append('coordinator/browsable-copy-01/navigation.json')
+    run(['git','add','--force','--',*paths]);run(['git','diff','--cached','--check','--','coordinator',*(['README.md'] if not original_readme else [])])
+    result['navigation_manifest_sha256']=sha(evidence/'navigation.json');save(root/'navigation.json',result)
+    (root/'prepared-with-navigation.patch').write_text(run(['git','diff','--cached','--binary']).stdout)
+    (root/'prepared-with-navigation-stat.txt').write_text(run(['git','diff','--cached','--stat']).stdout)
+    print(json.dumps({'root_navigation_added':not original_readme,'original_root_readme_preserved':bool(original_readme)}))
+except BaseException:

+++ b/coordinator/browsable-copy-01/prepare.py
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+"""Prepare one reviewed browsable copy; only coordinator files are authored."""
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+import hashlib, json, os, shutil, stat, subprocess, sys, traceback
+
+config_path = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+cfg = json.loads(config_path.read_text())
+root = Path(cfg['root']); repo = root / 'publisher'; repo.mkdir()
+main = Path('/Users/johnlee/code/CON/stamped-in-practice')
+pixi = ['pixi', 'run', '--manifest-path', str(main/'pixi.toml'), '--locked']
+host = json.loads(Path('/Users/johnlee/.config/stamped-in-practice/launch-neutral.json').read_text())
+canonical = cfg['canonical']; commands = []
+assert cfg['run_id'] != 'narps-neutral-r1-20'
+
+def sha(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open('rb') as stream:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024*1024), b''): h.update(chunk)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+def save(path, value): path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True)+'\n')
+
+def run(argv, allow=False):
+    p = subprocess.run(list(map(str, argv)), cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True)
+    commands.append({'argv':list(map(str, argv)), 'cwd':str(repo), 'returncode':p.returncode,
+                     'stdout':p.stdout, 'stderr':p.stderr})
+    save(root/'commands-prepare.json', commands)
+    if not allow: p.check_returncode()
+    return p
+
+try:
+    plan_path = Path(cfg['plan_path']); assert sha(plan_path) == cfg['plan_sha256']
+    plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text()); capture = Path(plan['capture_manifest']['path'])
+    assert plan['run_id'] == cfg['run_id'] == canonical['run_id']
+    assert sha(capture) == plan['capture_manifest']['sha256'] == canonical['capture_sha256']
+    assert plan['original_worker_head'] == canonical['worker_head_commit']
+    source_entries = {e['path']:e for e in json.loads(capture.read_text())['entries']}
+    inputs_path = Path(cfg['input_manifest_path']); route_path = Path(cfg['input_route_proof_path'])
+    assert sha(inputs_path) == cfg['input_manifest_sha256']
+    assert sha(route_path) == cfg['input_route_proof_sha256']
+    inputs = json.loads(inputs_path.read_text()); route = json.loads(route_path.read_text())
+    assert route['verified'] and route['input_files_verified'] == len(inputs['files']) == 58
+    assert route['input_manifest_sha256'] == cfg['input_manifest_sha256']
+    assert inputs['input_tree'] == canonical['input_tree']
+    run(['git','init','--initial-branch',cfg['branch']])
+    run(['git','remote','add','origin','git@github.com:leej3/stamped-in-practice.git'])
+    run(['git','config','remote.origin.annex-ignore','true'])
+    run(['git','fetch','--no-tags','origin',canonical['commit']])
+    run(['git','reset','--hard','FETCH_HEAD'])
+    assert run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).stdout.strip() == canonical['commit']
+    assert not (repo/'.git/objects/info/alternates').exists()
+    assert run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD:input']).stdout.strip() == inputs['input_tree']
+    assert run(['git','rev-parse',canonical['worker_head_commit']+':input']).stdout.strip() == inputs['input_tree']
+    run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',canonical['worker_head_commit'],'HEAD'])
+    assert sha(repo/'coordinator/original-manifest.json') == canonical['capture_sha256']
+    assert sha(repo/'coordinator/delivery-01/index.json') == canonical['package_index_sha256']
+    archive_tree = run(['git','ls-tree','HEAD','coordinator/delivery-01/delivery.tar.gz']).stdout
+    original_readme = run(['git','ls-tree','HEAD','README.md']).stdout
+    run(pixi+['git','annex','init',cfg['run_id']+' browsable coordinator copy'])
+    run(['git','remote','add',host['annex_remote'],host['annex_git_url']])
+    run(['git','config','remote.'+host['annex_remote']+'.annexurl',host['annex_url']])
+    run(['git','fetch','origin','git-annex:refs/remotes/origin/git-annex'])
+    run(pixi+['git','annex','merge'])
+    assert run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).stdout.strip() == canonical['commit']
+    # Preflight the complete reviewed plan before copying any original files.
+    for e in plan['entries']:
+        path = PurePosixPath(e['path']); assert not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
+        assert not any(c in e['path'] for c in '\n\r\0*?[]'), 'Unreviewed attribute pattern'
+        assert e['capture_path'] == 'content/workspace/'+e['path']
+        source = source_entries[e['capture_path']]
+        assert all(source.get(k) == e.get(k) for k in ['kind','mode','sha256','size','target'])
+        assert e['action'] in ['directory-no-placeholder','copy-to-git','copy-to-annex','preserve-literal-link']
+        dest = repo/e['path']; src = capture.parent/e['capture_path']
+        assert not dest.exists() and not dest.is_symlink(), 'Publisher collision: '+e['path']
+        assert stat.S_IMODE(src.lstat().st_mode) == e['mode']
+        if e['kind'] == 'file':
+            assert stat.S_ISREG(src.lstat().st_mode) and sha(src) == e['sha256'] and src.stat().st_size == e['size']
+        elif e['kind'] == 'symlink': assert os.readlink(src) == e['target']
+        else: assert e['kind'] == 'directory' and stat.S_ISDIR(src.lstat().st_mode)
+    copied = []
+    for e in plan['entries']:
+        if e['action'] == 'directory-no-placeholder': continue
+        dest = repo/e['path']; src = capture.parent/e['capture_path']; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        row = {'original_path':e['path'],'published_path':e['path'],'kind':e['kind'],'source_mode':e['mode']}
+        if e['kind'] == 'symlink':
+            os.symlink(e['target'], dest); row.update(storage='literal-link',target=e['target'])
+        else:
+            with src.open('rb') as source, dest.open('xb') as target: shutil.copyfileobj(source,target)
+            os.chmod(dest,e['mode']); assert sha(dest) == sha(src) == e['sha256']
+            row.update(bytes=e['size'],sha256=e['sha256'],storage='annex' if e['action']=='copy-to-annex' else 'git')
+        copied.append(row)
+    with (repo/'.gitattributes').open('a') as stream:
+        stream.write('\n# Coordinator presentation copies; original scientific bytes unchanged.\n')
+        for e in copied:
+            stream.write(json.dumps('/'+e['published_path'])+' annex.largefiles='+('anything annex.backend=SHA256E' if e['storage']=='annex' else 'nothing')+'\n')
+    annex = [e['published_path'] for e in copied if e['storage']=='annex']
+    if annex: run(pixi+['git','annex','add','--force-large','--backend=SHA256E','--',*annex])
+    for e in copied:
+        if e['storage']=='annex': e['annex_key']=run(pixi+['git','annex','lookupkey',e['published_path']]).stdout.strip()
+    evidence = repo/'coordinator/browsable-copy-01'; evidence.mkdir()
+    shutil.copy2(plan_path,evidence/'plan.json'); shutil.copy2(inputs_path,evidence/'input-manifest.json')
+    shutil.copy2(route_path,evidence/'shared-input-route-proof.json'); shutil.copy2(config_path,evidence/'config.json')
+    shutil.copy2(Path(__file__),evidence/'prepare.py')
+    manifest = {'schema':'coordinator-browsable-copy-v1','run_id':cfg['run_id'],'parent_commit':canonical['commit'],
+      'source_worker_head':plan['original_worker_head'],'capture_sha256':sha(capture),'plan_sha256':sha(plan_path),
+      'copied_files':copied,'authoritative_archive':'../delivery-01/delivery.tar.gz','authoritative_capture':'../original-manifest.json',
+      'attribution':'Coordinator presentation copies of exact original stopped files; no worker credit or scientific execution.',
+      'source_files_unchanged':True,'scientific_execution':False,'input_tree':inputs['input_tree'],
+      'shared_input_route_proof_sha256':sha(route_path),'shared_input_manifest_sha256':sha(inputs_path),
+      'shared_input_route_published_commit':cfg['input_route_published_proof_commit'],
+      'input_verification_scope':'Exact Git input tree matches prior independently retrieved 58-payload input manifest; payloads not redundantly downloaded for this presentation.',
+      'mode_scope':'Original full modes retained here and in authoritative archive; Git preserves executable bits and literal links, annex preserves payload bytes.'}
+    save(evidence/'manifest.json',manifest)
+    with (repo/'coordinator/README.md').open('a') as stream:
+        stream.write('\n## Browsable original files\n\nOriginal scientific files are also available at their unchanged workspace paths. '
+          'The [copy manifest](browsable-copy-01/manifest.json) records exact source hashes, original modes and storage choices. '
+          'These are coordinator presentation copies; the complete archive remains authoritative. '
+          'The input tree matches the [shared retrieval proof](browsable-copy-01/shared-input-route-proof.json); '
+          'its 58 payloads were independently retrieved in the cited run 20 check. '
+          'No scientific execution or worker credit is implied.\n')
+    cmd=pixi+['pre-commit','run','--config',str(main/'.pre-commit-config.yaml'),'snapper','--files','coordinator/README.md']
+    if run(cmd,allow=True).returncode: run(cmd)
+    run(['git','add','--force','--','.gitattributes','coordinator/README.md','coordinator/browsable-copy-01',*[e['published_path'] for e in copied]])
+    run(['git','diff','--cached','--check','--','.gitattributes','coordinator'])
+    assert run(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only','--','input','coordinator/delivery-01','coordinator/original-manifest.json']).stdout == ''
+    for e in copied:
+        path=e['published_path']; mode=run(['git','ls-files','--stage','--',path]).stdout.split()[0]
+        expected='120000' if e['storage'] in ['annex','literal-link'] else ('100755' if e['source_mode']&0o111 else '100644')
+        assert mode == expected
+        if e['kind']=='file': assert sha(repo/path) == e['sha256']
+        else: assert os.readlink(repo/path) == e['target']
+    assert sha(capture) == canonical['capture_sha256']
+    assert run(['git','ls-tree','HEAD','coordinator/delivery-01/delivery.tar.gz']).stdout == archive_tree
+    if not any(e['published_path']=='README.md' for e in copied):
+        assert run(['git','ls-tree','HEAD','README.md']).stdout == original_readme
+    diff=run(['git','diff','--cached','--stat']).stdout; (root/'prepared-diff-stat.txt').write_text(diff)
+    (root/'prepared.patch').write_text(run(['git','diff','--cached','--binary']).stdout)
+    save(root/'prepared.json',dict(manifest,publisher=str(repo),branch=cfg['branch'],annex_files=annex,
+       package_index_sha256=canonical['package_index_sha256'],plan_path=str(plan_path),config_sha256=sha(config_path)))
+    print(json.dumps({'prepared':True,'run_id':cfg['run_id'],'files':len(copied),'annex_files':len(annex),'committed':False}))
+except BaseException:
+    (root/'failure-prepare.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc()); raise

+# Potential gains and vmPFC activity in the NARPS equal-indifference group
+
+## Result
+
+**The supplied group maps do not support a positive gain effect in vmPFC under whole-brain corrected inference.** Across all 54 participants, the mean effect in an independently specified vmPFC core mask was 0.0018 contrast units (between-participant SD 0.0629; 95% t interval −0.0153 to 0.0190; one-sided uncorrected *p* = .416). The interval includes zero and effects in either direction; this is not an equivalence test.
+
+A one-sided whole-brain max-*T* permutation test did identify 23 significant voxels (*p*FWE ≤ .05), with the strongest at MNI (−26, −102, −3.6), *t*(53) = 6.62, *p*FWE = .0009. This is posterior left occipital cortex, not vmPFC, and does not support the stated regional hypothesis. The small non-target finding should be interpreted cautiously; it is a whole-brain result, not an independently replicated effect.
+
+![Positive voxels surviving one-sided whole-brain max-T family-wise error correction](figures/whole_brain_fwe_findings.png)
+
+The uncorrected group map is shown for anatomical context only. Its display threshold (*p* < .001 uncorrected) is not the inferential threshold.
+
+![Uncorrected group t map and vmPFC view](figures/group_t_map.png)
+
+## Analysis
+
+The 54 AO86 participant gain contrast estimates (COPEs) were tested with an equal-weight one-sample random-effects *t* model against zero (*df* = 53). Each value is an upstream participant-level contrast estimate—not a *t*/*z* statistic. An independently specified vmPFC core envelope (MNI x = −15 to 15, y = 20 to 55, z = −20 to 5 mm) was used to summarize the target-region estimate and its uncertainty. This broad anatomical summary is descriptive; the confirmatory search was whole brain, consistent with the [original NARPS analysis instructions](https://www.narps.info/files/narps_instructions_for_analysis_teams.pdf), which require whole-brain corrected evidence for the named region.
+
+The primary inference used 9,999 random sign flips of participant effects and the maximum positive *t* statistic across the analysis mask on each permutation, controlling voxelwise family-wise error at .05. The analysis mask was the intersection of a standard MNI brain mask and nonzero locations across all 54 maps. The latter avoids treating zeros outside individual estimation support as observed zero effects. It contains 186,400 voxels; 2,687 fall in the vmPFC core. All maps had the same 97 × 115 × 81 grid, 2 × 2 × 2.4 mm voxel spacing and affine; all 54 participant IDs matched metadata. No participants were excluded. The full group *t* map, max-*T* adjusted *p* map, thresholded significant *t* map, JSON summary and run log are in `results/`.
+
+![Participant vmPFC-core mean effects and group interval](figures/vmPFC_participant_effects.png)
+
+## Interpretation and limits
+
+A lack of corrected vmPFC support means this analysis did not detect evidence strong enough to pass whole-brain family-wise error control in that region. It does **not** show that the true effect is zero or rule out a smaller effect; the descriptive interval remains compatible with positive and negative effects.
+
+The gain modulator was mean-centered and variance-normalized before HRF convolution. Thus, the supplied coefficient is not a response change per currency unit. Response-time duration, choice regressors, motion, flagged volumes and drift were included upstream, while gain and loss were modeled separately; the estimate is conditional on those fixed choices. Because participant variance maps and an executable upstream model are unavailable, the group test gives participants equal weight and cannot account for differing first-level precision. Sign-flip inference also assumes participant effects are exchangeable and null errors are symmetric. The common-support mask excludes locations not estimated for every participant. The analysis tests the supplied contrast in this group; it does not establish causality or directly compare the gain and loss range manipulation.
+
+## Reproducibility
+
+Run `analysis/group_analysis.py` with the supplied Python environment. Outputs are written to `results/` and `figures/`; numeric results are in `results/summary.json`. Inputs and fixed modeling details are documented in `input/sources.json` and `input/upstream-methods.md`.
